# KRSA analysis based on PamGeneAnalyzeR outputs

## Load packages

```{r}
library(KRSA)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(broom)
library(EnvStats)

analysis_started_at <- Sys.time()
analysis_proc_start <- proc.time()
```

## Configuration

```{r}
repo_root <- NULL
for (candidate in c(".", "..")) {
  candidate_path <- normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(file.path(candidate_path, "tests", "outDir_PTK")) &&
      file.exists(file.path(candidate_path, "tests", "outDir_STK"))) {
    repo_root <- candidate_path
    break
  }
}

if (is.null(repo_root)) {
  stop("Could not locate the repository root from the current working directory.")
}

repo_path <- function(...) {
  file.path(repo_root, ...)
}

sample_annotation_path <- repo_path(
  "results",
  "20260402160155_Kerthi_HDV_Aug24",
  "710483213_710483216-on 1300STKlysv10-run 240821110734",
  "20260402160155_data_enrichment.csv"
)

out_dir_PTK <- repo_path("tests", "outDir_PTK")
out_dir_STK <- repo_path("tests", "outDir_STK")
krsa_output_dir <- repo_path("tests", "krsa_from_pamgene")

group_col <- "Test.Condition"
control_label <- "Control"

# KRSA's bundled report template uses signal_threshold = 5 for BioNavigator
# I_median crosstab files. The PamGeneAnalyzeR-derived values here are on
# a much smaller scale, so we keep this threshold near zero by default.
signal_scale_factor <- 1000
signal_threshold <- 0
r2_threshold <- 0.9
nobs_filter <- 0
lfc_thresholds <- c(0.05, 0.1, 0.2)
primary_lfc_threshold <- 0.05

krsa_seed <- 123
krsa_iterations <- 2000
```

## Helper functions

```{r}
negative_control_names <- c(
  "right_background1", "right_background2",
  "left_background1", "left_background2",
  "top_background1", "top_background2",
  "bottom_background1", "bottom_background2"
)

assert_existing_txt_output <- function(path, label) {
  txt_files <- list.files(path, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (!length(txt_files)) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "%s does not contain PamGeneAnalyzeR TXT outputs: %s",
      label,
      path
    ))
  }
  txt_files
}

mixed_levels_base <- function(values) {
  values_chr <- as.character(values)
  unique_values <- unique(values_chr)
  unique_numeric <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(sub("^.*?([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?).*$", "\\1", unique_values))
  )
  unique_values[order(is.na(unique_numeric), unique_numeric, unique_values)]
}

resolve_spot_labels <- function(df) {
  labels <- df$ID
  use_names <- (is.na(labels) | labels == "#REF") & !is.na(df$names) & df$names != ""
  labels[use_names] <- df$names[use_names]
  labels
}

merge_experiments_compatible <- function(path, pattern = NULL, value = "median") {
  batch <- sort(dir(path = path, pattern = pattern))
  d <- NULL

  for (filename in batch) {
    pam <- pamgeneAnalyzeR::pamgeneObject(file = file.path(path, filename))
    labels <- resolve_spot_labels(pam$data)
    keep <- !is.na(labels) & labels != "#REF"
    tmp <- pam$data[keep, value]
    names(tmp) <- labels[keep]

    d <- rbind(
      d,
      data.frame(
        chipID = pam$chipID,
        well = pam$well,
        cycle = pam$cycle,
        exposureTime = pam$exposureTime,
        t(tmp),
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  d$cycle <- factor(as.character(d$cycle), levels = mixed_levels_base(d$cycle))
  d$exposureTime <- factor(as.character(d$exposureTime), levels = mixed_levels_base(d$exposureTime))
  d
}

subtract_background_compatible <- function(rawData) {
  pheno_cols <- intersect(c("chipID", "well", "exposureTime", "cycle", "ZpFactor"), names(rawData))
  signal_cols <- setdiff(names(rawData), pheno_cols)

  missing_neg_controls <- setdiff(negative_control_names, signal_cols)
  if (length(missing_neg_controls)) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Missing required background controls: %s",
      paste(missing_neg_controls, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  negative_means <- rowMeans(rawData[negative_control_names], na.rm = FALSE)
  normalized_signal <- as.data.frame(
    sweep(as.matrix(rawData[signal_cols]), 1, negative_means, FUN = "-"),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  data.frame(rawData[pheno_cols], normalized_signal, check.names = FALSE)
}

wide_metric_to_long <- function(df, value_name) {
  pheno_cols <- intersect(c("chipID", "well", "exposureTime", "cycle", "ZpFactor"), names(df))
  signal_cols <- setdiff(names(df), pheno_cols)

  long_df <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(signal_cols, function(signal_col) {
      tmp <- df[pheno_cols]
      tmp$ID <- signal_col
      tmp[[value_name]] <- df[[signal_col]]
      tmp
    })
  )

  long_df$Barcode <- as.integer(long_df$chipID)
  long_df$Row <- as.integer(sub("^W", "", as.character(long_df$well)))
  long_df$ExposureTime <- as.integer(sub("^T", "", as.character(long_df$exposureTime)))
  long_df$Cycle <- as.integer(sub("^P", "", as.character(long_df$cycle)))
  long_df
}

build_krsa_tidy_from_outdir <- function(out_dir, sample_annotation, type, group_col = "Test.Condition") {
  annotation_tbl <- sample_annotation %>%
    dplyr::filter(Type == type) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Barcode = as.integer(Barcode),
      Row = as.integer(Row),
      SampleLabel = Sample.name,
      SampleName = paste0(Sample.name, "_B", Barcode, "_W", Row),
      Group = .data[[group_col]],
      Construct = Construct,
      Biological.Replicate = Biological.Replicate,
      Technical.Replicate = Technical.Replicate
    )

  duplicated_annotation_names <- duplicated(annotation_tbl$SampleName)
  if (any(duplicated_annotation_names)) {
    stop("SampleName values are not unique in the sample annotation table.")
  }

  median_wide <- merge_experiments_compatible(out_dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", value = "median")
  median_bg <- subtract_background_compatible(median_wide)
  median_long <- wide_metric_to_long(median_bg, "Signal")

  krsa_input <- median_long %>%
    dplyr::rename(Peptide = ID) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!Peptide %in% negative_control_names) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(annotation_tbl, by = c("Barcode", "Row")) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      SampleName, SampleLabel, Group, Barcode, Row, ExposureTime, Cycle,
      Peptide, Signal, Construct, Biological.Replicate, Technical.Replicate
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(SampleName), !is.na(Group), is.finite(Signal)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  krsa_input
}

# This mirrors KRSA::krsa_scaleModel() but uses an explicit tidyr::nest()
# signature and numeric coercions so it remains stable on the current data and
# package stack.
krsa_scaleModel_compatible <- function(df, pep, nobs_filter = 0) {
  df_model <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Peptide %in% pep) %>%
    dplyr::select(SampleName, Peptide, Group, Barcode, Signal, ExposureTime) %>%
    tidyr::nest(data = c(Signal, ExposureTime)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(SampleName, Peptide) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fit = purrr::map(data, ~ stats::lm(Signal ~ ExposureTime + 0, data = .x)),
      coefs = purrr::map(fit, broom::tidy),
      summary = purrr::map(fit, broom::glance),
      slope = purrr::map_dbl(coefs, purrr::pluck, 2, .default = 0),
      r.seq = purrr::map_dbl(summary, "r.squared"),
      nobs = purrr::map_dbl(summary, "nobs")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(Group, Barcode, SampleName, Peptide, slope, r.seq, nobs) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      slope = log2(slope * 100),
      slope = dplyr::if_else(slope < 0, NA_real_, slope),
      slope = dplyr::if_else(nobs >= nobs_filter, slope, NA_real_),
      r.seq = dplyr::if_else(nobs >= nobs_filter, r.seq, NA_real_)
    )

  df_model_norm <- df_model %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Barcode, Peptide) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Mean = mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      slope = dplyr::if_else(Mean == 0, 0, slope / Mean)
    )

  df_model_grouped <- df_model %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Group, Peptide) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      slope = EnvStats::geoMean(as.numeric(slope), na.rm = TRUE),
      r.seq = EnvStats::geoMean(as.numeric(r.seq), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  list(
    scaled = df_model,
    normalized = df_model_norm,
    grouped = df_model_grouped
  )
}

build_comparisons <- function(groups, control_label = "Control") {
  case_groups <- setdiff(sort(unique(groups)), control_label)
  comparisons <- lapply(case_groups, function(case_group) c(case_group, control_label))
  names(comparisons) <- paste0(case_groups, "_vs_", control_label)
  comparisons
}

save_krsa_zscore_plot <- function(z_table, output_path) {
  if (!nrow(z_table)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  plot_tbl <- z_table %>%
    dplyr::mutate(AvgZ = Z)

  p <- KRSA::krsa_zscores_plot(plot_tbl)

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = output_path,
    plot = p,
    width = 8,
    height = max(5, min(14, 0.18 * nrow(plot_tbl))),
    dpi = 150,
    bg = "white"
  )

  output_path
}

run_krsa_for_type <- function(type, out_dir, sample_annotation, map_file, coverage_file,
                              output_dir, signal_threshold = 0, r2_threshold = 0.9,
                              signal_scale_factor = 1000, nobs_filter = 0,
                              lfc_thresholds = c(0.05, 0.1, 0.2),
                              primary_lfc_threshold = 0.05, control_label = "Control",
                              group_col = "Test.Condition", krsa_iterations = 2000,
                              krsa_seed = 123) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  krsa_input <- build_krsa_tidy_from_outdir(out_dir, sample_annotation, type, group_col = group_col)
  krsa_input <- krsa_input %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Signal = Signal * signal_scale_factor)
  write.csv(krsa_input, file.path(output_dir, paste0("krsa_input_", type, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  mapped_peptides <- sort(intersect(unique(krsa_input$Peptide), unique(map_file$Substrates)))
  if (!length(mapped_peptides)) {
    stop(sprintf("No peptides from %s matched the KRSA mapping file.", type))
  }

  krsa_input <- krsa_input %>%
    dplyr::filter(Peptide %in% mapped_peptides)

  endpoint_max <- KRSA::krsa_extractEndPointMaxExp(krsa_input, type)
  endpoint_all <- KRSA::krsa_extractEndPoint(krsa_input, type)
  modeled <- krsa_scaleModel_compatible(endpoint_all, mapped_peptides, nobs_filter = nobs_filter)

  write.csv(endpoint_max, file.path(output_dir, paste0("endpoint_max_", type, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(modeled$scaled, file.path(output_dir, paste0("modeled_scaled_", type, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(modeled$normalized, file.path(output_dir, paste0("modeled_normalized_", type, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(modeled$grouped, file.path(output_dir, paste0("modeled_grouped_", type, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  input_summary <- tibble::tibble(
    Type = type,
    Samples = length(unique(krsa_input$SampleName)),
    Groups = length(unique(krsa_input$Group)),
    MappedPeptides = length(mapped_peptides),
    Rows = nrow(krsa_input),
    SignalScaleFactor = signal_scale_factor,
    SignalThreshold = signal_threshold,
    R2Threshold = r2_threshold,
    PrimaryLFCThreshold = primary_lfc_threshold
  )

  comparisons <- build_comparisons(krsa_input$Group, control_label = control_label)
  comparison_summaries <- list()
  zscore_plot_paths <- character(0)

  for (comparison_name in names(comparisons)) {
    groups_to_compare <- comparisons[[comparison_name]]
    case_group <- groups_to_compare[1]
    control_group <- groups_to_compare[2]

    comparison_prefix <- file.path(output_dir, comparison_name)

    pep_passed_qc <- tryCatch(
      KRSA::krsa_quick_filter(
        data = endpoint_max,
        data2 = modeled$scaled,
        signal_threshold = signal_threshold,
        r2_threshold = r2_threshold,
        groups = groups_to_compare
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message(sprintf("QC failed for %s %s: %s", type, comparison_name, e$message))
        character(0)
      }
    )

    write.csv(
      data.frame(Peptide = pep_passed_qc),
      paste0(comparison_prefix, "_qc_passed_peptides.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    if (!length(pep_passed_qc)) {
      comparison_summaries[[comparison_name]] <- tibble::tibble(
        Type = type,
        Comparison = comparison_name,
        CaseGroup = case_group,
        ControlGroup = control_group,
        QCPassedPeptides = 0,
        PrimaryMeanHits = 0,
        PrimaryByChipHits = 0,
        PrimaryCombinedHits = 0,
        KRSAKinases = 0,
        Status = "No peptides passed KRSA QC"
      )
      next
    }

    diff_df <- KRSA::krsa_group_diff(
      modeled$scaled,
      groups_to_compare,
      pep_passed_qc,
      byChip = TRUE
    )
    write.csv(diff_df, paste0(comparison_prefix, "_lfc_table.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    mean_hits <- KRSA::krsa_get_diff(diff_df, totalMeanLFC, lfc_thresholds)
    bychip_hits <- KRSA::krsa_get_diff_byChip(diff_df, LFC, lfc_thresholds)

    threshold_key <- as.character(primary_lfc_threshold)
    primary_mean_hits <- sort(unique(mean_hits[[threshold_key]]))
    primary_bychip_hits <- sort(unique(bychip_hits[[threshold_key]]))
    primary_combined_hits <- sort(unique(c(primary_mean_hits, primary_bychip_hits)))

    write.csv(
      data.frame(Peptide = primary_mean_hits),
      paste0(comparison_prefix, "_primary_mean_hits.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    write.csv(
      data.frame(Peptide = primary_bychip_hits),
      paste0(comparison_prefix, "_primary_bychip_hits.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
    write.csv(
      data.frame(Peptide = primary_combined_hits),
      paste0(comparison_prefix, "_primary_combined_hits.csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    if (!length(primary_combined_hits)) {
      comparison_summaries[[comparison_name]] <- tibble::tibble(
        Type = type,
        Comparison = comparison_name,
        CaseGroup = case_group,
        ControlGroup = control_group,
        QCPassedPeptides = length(pep_passed_qc),
        PrimaryMeanHits = length(primary_mean_hits),
        PrimaryByChipHits = length(primary_bychip_hits),
        PrimaryCombinedHits = 0,
        KRSAKinases = 0,
        Status = "No hit peptides at primary LFC threshold"
      )
      next
    }

    krsa_output <- KRSA::krsa(
      primary_combined_hits,
      itr = krsa_iterations,
      seed = krsa_seed,
      return_count = TRUE,
      map_file = map_file,
      cov_file = coverage_file
    )

    z_table <- krsa_output$KRSA_Table
    write.csv(z_table, paste0(comparison_prefix, "_krsa_zscores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(krsa_output$count_mtx, paste0(comparison_prefix, "_krsa_count_matrix.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    zscore_plot_path <- save_krsa_zscore_plot(
      z_table,
      paste0(comparison_prefix, "_krsa_zscores.png")
    )

    if (!is.na(zscore_plot_path)) {
      zscore_plot_paths <- c(zscore_plot_paths, zscore_plot_path)
    }

    comparison_summaries[[comparison_name]] <- tibble::tibble(
      Type = type,
      Comparison = comparison_name,
      CaseGroup = case_group,
      ControlGroup = control_group,
      QCPassedPeptides = length(pep_passed_qc),
      PrimaryMeanHits = length(primary_mean_hits),
      PrimaryByChipHits = length(primary_bychip_hits),
      PrimaryCombinedHits = length(primary_combined_hits),
      KRSAKinases = nrow(z_table),
      Status = "KRSA completed"
    )
  }

  comparison_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(comparison_summaries)
  write.csv(comparison_summary, file.path(output_dir, paste0("comparison_summary_", type, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  list(
    input_summary = input_summary,
    comparison_summary = comparison_summary,
    zscore_plot_paths = zscore_plot_paths
  )
}
```

## Sample annotation

```{r}
assert_existing_txt_output(out_dir_PTK, "PTK output directory")
assert_existing_txt_output(out_dir_STK, "STK output directory")

sample_annotation <- read.csv(sample_annotation_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sample_annotation
```

## Run KRSA for PTK and STK

```{r}
dir.create(krsa_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ptk_results <- run_krsa_for_type(
  type = "PTK",
  out_dir = out_dir_PTK,
  sample_annotation = sample_annotation,
  map_file = KRSA_Mapping_PTK_PamChip_86402_v1,
  coverage_file = KRSA_coverage_PTK_PamChip_86402_v1,
  output_dir = file.path(krsa_output_dir, "PTK"),
  signal_threshold = signal_threshold,
  r2_threshold = r2_threshold,
  signal_scale_factor = signal_scale_factor,
  nobs_filter = nobs_filter,
  lfc_thresholds = lfc_thresholds,
  primary_lfc_threshold = primary_lfc_threshold,
  control_label = control_label,
  group_col = group_col,
  krsa_iterations = krsa_iterations,
  krsa_seed = krsa_seed
)

stk_results <- run_krsa_for_type(
  type = "STK",
  out_dir = out_dir_STK,
  sample_annotation = sample_annotation,
  map_file = KRSA_Mapping_STK_PamChip_87102_v1,
  coverage_file = KRSA_coverage_STK_PamChip_87102_v2,
  output_dir = file.path(krsa_output_dir, "STK"),
  signal_threshold = signal_threshold,
  r2_threshold = r2_threshold,
  signal_scale_factor = signal_scale_factor,
  nobs_filter = nobs_filter,
  lfc_thresholds = lfc_thresholds,
  primary_lfc_threshold = primary_lfc_threshold,
  control_label = control_label,
  group_col = group_col,
  krsa_iterations = krsa_iterations,
  krsa_seed = krsa_seed
)
```

## Available KRSA Z score plots

```{r, results='asis'}
zscore_plot_paths <- c(ptk_results$zscore_plot_paths, stk_results$zscore_plot_paths)
zscore_plot_paths <- unique(zscore_plot_paths[file.exists(zscore_plot_paths)])
zscore_plot_paths <- normalizePath(zscore_plot_paths, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

if (length(zscore_plot_paths)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(zscore_plot_paths, rel_path = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No KRSA Z score plots were generated at the current thresholds.")
}
```

## Runtime

```{r}
analysis_finished_at <- Sys.time()
analysis_proc_elapsed <- proc.time() - analysis_proc_start

runtime_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  started_at = format(analysis_started_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
  finished_at = format(analysis_finished_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
  wall_seconds = as.numeric(difftime(analysis_finished_at, analysis_started_at, units = "secs")),
  wall_minutes = wall_seconds / 60,
  cpu_user_seconds = unname(analysis_proc_elapsed[["user.self"]]),
  cpu_system_seconds = unname(analysis_proc_elapsed[["sys.self"]]),
  cpu_elapsed_seconds = unname(analysis_proc_elapsed[["elapsed"]])
)

write.csv(
  runtime_summary,
  file.path(krsa_output_dir, "krsa_runtime_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

runtime_summary
```
